blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Continuous and up-to-date crop type mapping is essential for agricultural monitoring but is often hampered by limited reference data. The growing availability of ground-level field photographs offers a promising way to address this challenge. When combined with satellite time series, these images provide complementary perspectives on the same parcel, capturing crop characteristics from distinctly different perspectives. However, field photographs are not always available for each satellite pixel at inference time, limiting their potential in scalable crop type mapping. We investigate whether ground photographs can provide privileged supervision for crop classification built on pretrained satellite embeddings. A photo teacher based on frozen CLIP features supervises classifiers trained on AlphaEarth and TESSERA representations; photographs are used only during training. On a paired field photo and satellite imagery dataset with 17 crop classes, knowledge distillation consistently improves over satellite-only classification; for frozen embeddings the margin grows under temporal shift, reaching up to +5.5 macro-F1 points, and widens in geographic holdouts (+3.7 vs +3.0 in-distribution). These results show that ground-view supervision can complement satellite embeddings and improve their robustness without changing inference requirements.
blocks.zh: 持续和最新的作物类型测绘对农业监测至关重要,但往往受到有限参考数据的阻碍。 地面实地照片越来越多,为应付这一挑战提供了有希望的途径。 这些图像与卫星时间序列相结合,为同一个包裹提供了互补的视角,从截然不同的视角捕捉作物特征。 然而,在推算时间并不总是可以获得每个卫星像素的实地照片,这限制了其在可伸缩作物类型的绘图方面的潜力。 我们调查地面照片是否能够对利用预先训练过的卫星嵌入的作物分类提供特权监督。 一个基于被冻结的CLIP特性的相片教师监督接受过阿尔法地表和TESSERA表示法培训的分类人员;照片只在培训期间使用. 在一个配对的有17个作物类的野外相片和卫星图像数据集上,知识分馏比仅用卫星分类不断改进;对于被冻结的嵌入物,比值在时间变化后会增加,达到+5.5个宏观-F1分点,在地理阻力上会扩大(+3.7对+3.0分流)。 这些结果表明,地面观测监督可以补充卫星嵌入并提高其稳健性而不会改变推论要求。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Ground photographs offer a complementary perspective to satellite data and are becoming increasingly available for crop monitoring through both crowdsourcing platforms ( Garcin et al., 2021 ) and field data collection protocols ( Nakalembe et al., 2025 ; d’Andrimont et al., 2022 ) . For instance, the Land Use/Cover Area Frame survey (LUCAS) pairs georeferenced survey points across Europe with ground photographs, providing fine-grained crop characteristics such as leaf shape, structure, and texture that are difficult to capture from satellite data alone ( d’Andrimont et al., 2022 ) . Such information can remain informative when satellite signature change across space or time and thus contributes to robust crop type mapping ( Abbas et al., 2025 ) . However, the drawback is obvious: ground photographs are limited to surveyed locations and are rarely available on demand, which makes them impractical when rapid, scalable inference is required. This is a learning-using-privileged-information setting ( Vapnik and Vashist, 2009 ) , for which Knowledge Distillation (KD) is a practical implementation ( Hinton et al., 2015 ; Lopez-Paz et al., 2016 ) .
We hypothesize that paired ground photographs provide a complementary semantic view of crop type that can improve robustness when scaling across regions and years ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . From an operational perspective, crop type maps require frequent updating to account for the highly dynamic nature of agricultural systems. Recent advances in geospatial foundation-models (GFMs) offer the potential to streamline data preparation and substantially reduce Earth Observation (EO) data requirements by leveraging frozen embeddings for continuous mapping. However, limited reference data remains a key constraint, as classifiers trained on labels from specific geographic and temporal domains can suffer from distribution shifts, leading to misclassification ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . Such shifts arise because satellite observations are influenced not only by crop characteristics but also by climate, phenology, land management, and acquisition conditions ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , causing the same crop to exhibit different satellite signatures across domains. Ground photographs provide a complementary view of the same parcel that is less affected by these factors. Distilling the ground view into the classifier may therefore anchor predictions to crop-relevant cues that are more consistent across geographic and temporal domains. This is particularly relevant when classifiers are trained on frozen GFM embeddings, where the downstream model has limited ability to compensate for region- or time-specific biases encoded in the representation. Building on the hypothesis that ground photographs provide complementary semantic information about crops, we investigate whether this information can be transferred to satellite-based classifiers to improve their robustness across geographic and temporal domains. Because ground photographs are not consistently available across space and time, we use a ground photo teacher only during training. Ground photographs are encoded with CLIP ViT-B/32 ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , pretrained on approximately 400 million web-collected image–text pairs; a small photo teacher classifier is trained per seed and then frozen. Satellite students learn from the labels together with the teacher’s logits and embeddings. At inference, the student receives satellite data only. We keep the teacher and loss fixed while changing the satellite branch, considering: (i) frozen embeddings from AlphaEarth ( Brown et al., 2025 ) and TESSERA ( Feng et al., 2025 ) , (ii) sequence transformers trained from scratch on monthly satellite time series, and (iii) a partially fine-tuned TESSERA encoder.
blocks.zh:
地面照片为卫星数据提供了补充视角,并越来越多地通过众包平台(Garcin等人,2021年)和实地数据收集协议(Nakalembe等人,2025年;d ' Andrimont等人,2022年)供作物监测使用。 例如,土地利用/覆盖区框架调查(LUCAS)将欧洲各地的地理参照调查点与地面照片联系起来,提供了叶子形状、结构和纹理等难以从卫星数据中获取的精细作物特征(d ' Andrimont等人,2022年)。 当卫星在空间或时间上的签字发生变化时,这种信息仍可保持翔实性,从而有助于绘制强有力的作物类型图(Abbas等人,2025年)。 然而,缺点是显而易见的:地面照片仅限于勘测地点,而且很少按要求提供,这就使得在需要快速,可伸缩的推论时照片不切实际. 这是一个学习-使用-特权-信息设置(Vapnik和Vashist,2009年),为此,知识消化(KD)是一个实际实施(Hinton等人,2015年;Lopez-Paz等人,2016年)。
我们假设,配对的地面照片提供了作物类型的补充语义视图,可以在跨区域和跨年扩大时提高稳健性(Wang等人,2025年)。 从操作角度看,作物类型图需要经常更新,以考虑到农业系统的高度动态性质。 地理空间基础模型(GFMs)的近期进展提供了通过利用冻结嵌入物进行连续测绘来简化数据编制和大幅减少地球观测数据需求的潜力。 然而,有限的参考数据仍然是一个重要的制约因素,因为接受过特定地理和时间域标签培训的分类人员可能会受到分布变化的影响,导致分类错误(Wang等人,2025年)。 出现这种变化是因为卫星观测不仅受到作物特征的影响,而且还受到气候、植物学、土地管理和获取条件的影响(Wang等人,2025年),导致同一作物在不同领域表现出不同的卫星特征。 地面照片是同一包裹的补充视图,受这些因素影响较小。 因此,将地面视图分解到分类器中,可以将预测定位到各个地域和时间领域更加一致的作物相关提示。 在对分类人员进行冷冻GFM嵌入式培训时,这一点尤其重要,因为下游模式在补偿代表中编码的区域或时间偏差方面能力有限。 基于地面照片提供作物补充语义信息这一假设,我们调查是否可以将这些信息转移到卫星分类器上,以提高其跨越地理和时间领域的稳健性。 由于地面照片在空间和时间上并不一致,我们只在培训期间使用地面照片教师。 地面照片用CLIP VIT-B/32编码(Radford等人,2021年),对大约4亿个网络收集的图像-文本对进行预训;对每个种子都进行小型照片教师分类,然后冷冻。 卫星学生与老师的对数和嵌入法一起学习标签。 推论,学生只接收卫星数据. 我们在改变卫星分支时固定教师和损失,考虑到:(一) 来自AlphaEarth(Brown等人,2025年)和TESSERA(Feng等人,2025年)的冷冻嵌入物;(二) 从零开始在卫星时序上训练的序列变压器;(三) 部分微调的TESSERA编码器。

blocks.en: To assess the effectiveness of the proposed multimodal framework, we make three controlled comparisons. First, under the same teacher and training budget, we compare the KD–Cross Entropy (CE) difference across satellite models based on frozen and from-scratch representations. Second, we evaluate these models under temporal transfer (2018 → \rightarrow 2022) and, for AlphaEarth, held-out ecoregions, i.e., geographically distinct ecological regions ( Dinerstein et al., 2017 ) . Third, we test partial fine-tuning of TESSERA while explicitly quantifying the mismatch introduced by our monthly-composite processing of satellite data. Across the main frozen and from-scratch regimes, KD consistently improves in-domain macro-F1 across the satellite branches, by up to 5.1 points on frozen TESSERA, and the frozen-embedding margins grow further under temporal shift and in the Mediterranean geographic holdout.
blocks.zh: 为了评估拟议的多式联运框架的有效性,我们进行了三项有控制的比较。 首先,在同样的教师和培训预算下,我们比较了基于冷冻和碎屑表示的卫星模型之间的KD-Cross Entropy(CE)差异。 第二,我们在时间转移(2018 ~\rightarrow 2022)下评估这些模型,对于阿尔法地球,被搁置的生态区域,即地理上不同的生态区域(Dinerstein等人,2017年)。 第三,我们对TESSERA进行部分微调测试,同时明确量化我们每月对卫星数据进行复合处理所产生的不匹配情况。 在整个主要的冷冻和碎屑制度下,KD在卫星分支的域内宏观F1不断改进,在冷冻的TESSERA上增加多达5.1分,在时间转移和地中海地理阻力下,冷冻嵌入的边际进一步扩大。

blocks.en: Data. To test the proposed approach, we use LUCAS 2018 survey points with ground photographs ( d’Andrimont et al., 2022 ) for training, focusing on the 17 classes of the Copernicus High Resolution Layer Croplands (CLMS) products ( Fahl et al., 2026 ) . The paired dataset contains 53,885 points with a label, photo, and time series of satellite data. The canonical split follows 70/15/15 for train/validation/test and is fixed across the main comparisons. The 2 × \times 2 km LUCAS grid ensures spatially separated, non-overlapping observations, reducing potential spatial dependence between splits. Satellite inputs are either released 64-D AlphaEarth ( Brown et al., 2025 ) and TESSERA ( Feng et al., 2025 ) embeddings, or 12 monthly composites of Sentinel-2 (10 bands) and Sentinel-1 (VV/VH) over a 3 × 3 3\times 3 pixel patch ( 30 30 m × 30 \times 30 m) centered around the LUCAS point. Figure 1 provides an overview of the spatial distribution of crop types (a), Sentinel-2 composites, the in-situ photograph, and the crop type distribution (d). Temporal transfer. Models trained on LUCAS 2018 are evaluated without adaptation on LUCAS 2022. The class mapping and normalization constants fitted on 2018 are reused, and geographical locations belonging to the 2018 train or validation sets are excluded from the 2022 transfer set. The resulting transfer set contains 36,428 points with a satellite feature and one of the 17 classes, at locations unseen during training. Geographic transfer. Geographic transfer is evaluated entirely within 2018, isolating spatial from temporal domain shift. EEA ecoregions define fixed geographic test domains ( European Environment Agency, 2016 ) : Mediterranean, Alpine, and Boreal are held out in turn, while the remaining 2018 points are split into training and validation sets. CE and KD are paired on the same split. Our input construction does not follow TESSERA’s inference pattern: irregular acquisitions are reduced to 12 monthly composites, missing months become mean-valued observations with a valid mid-month day-of-year, and orbit-merged S1 uses averaged ascending/descending normalization statistics. A linear probe scores 36.2 ± 1.6 36.2\pm 1.6 macro-F1 on embeddings from this frozen monthly-input path and 43.6 ± 1.6 43.6\pm 1.6 on the released TESSERA embeddings, a − 7.4 -7.4 point difference. We therefore treat the released embedding and our monthly-input setting as separate regimes rather than using their difference in macro-F1 as an estimate of the effect of fine-tuning. The reported main experiments use five seeds. Macro-F1 is computed on the same evaluation set for each paired CE/KD run, using the fixed 17-label taxonomy.
blocks.zh: 数据。 为了测试拟议方法,我们使用带有地面照片的LUCAS 2018测量点(d ' Andrimont等人,2022年)进行培训,重点是哥白尼高分辨率地层作物地块(CLMS)产品的17个课程(Fahl等人,2026年)。 配对数据集包含53,885个点,并附有标签,照片,以及卫星数据的时间序列. 车厢拆分在70/15/15后进行列车/验证/测试,并固定在主比较. 2×\times 2 km LUCAS网格确保空间分离,非重叠观测,减少分裂之间潜在的空间依赖. 卫星投入要么释放64-D AlphaEarth(Brown 等人,2025年)和TESERA(Feng 等人,2025年)嵌入,要么在LUCAS点周围以3×3×3的3像素补丁(30 30米×30厘米)为中心发射12个月度复合材料Sentinel-2(10个波段)和Sentinel-1(VV/VH). 图1概述了作物类型(a)、哨兵-2复合材料的空间分布、现场照片和作物类型分布(d)。 临时转移。 在LUCAS 2018上经过培训的模型在LUCAS 2022上未经修改而进行评估. 2018年装配的等级测绘和常态常数被重新使用,属于2018年列车或验证组的地理位置被排除在2022年调车组之外. 由此产生的转移装置包括36 428个带卫星功能的点和17个班之一,地点在培训期间未见。 地理转移. 地理转移完全在2018年内部评估,将空间与时域转移隔离. EEA生态区定义了固定的地理测试域(欧洲环境署,2016年): 地中海,阿尔卑斯山和博雷利环形山依次举行,其余2018年的积分则分为培训和验证组. CE和KD在同一拆分上配对. 我们的投入构建并不遵循TESSERA的推论模式:不定期的收购减少到12个月复合材料,缺失月成为平均值观测,年中日有效,轨道出现的S1使用平均升降常态统计。 线性探测器在从这个冻结的月输入路径嵌入时得分36.2±1.6 36.2\pm 1.6 宏-F1,在释放的TESSERA嵌入时得分43.6±1.6 43.6\pm 1.6,差值−7.4-7.4点. 因此,我们将释放的嵌入和我们的月投入设定作为单独的制度,而不是用它们在宏观-F1中的差异来估计微调的效果。 报道的主要实验使用五种种子. 宏 F1采用固定的17标签分类法,在每对CE/KD运行的同一套评价中计算.

blocks.en: 4 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 4 结果和讨论

blocks.en: Table 1 shows a consistent in-domain improvement of 2.6–5.1 macro-F1 points for the frozen and from-scratch students, largest on frozen TESSERA. Partial TESSERA fine-tuning (Sec. 2 ) gives the best absolute result, 72.1 macro-F1, with up to + 2.4 +2.4 macro-F1 over the teacher, but the paired KD margin is smaller at + 0.8 +0.8 macro-F1. Because this branch uses the monthly input path above, this margin is not a controlled estimate of the effect of fine-tuning alone.

blocks.en:
Transfer Experiments. Figure 2 (left) shows the paired KD − - CE margin for every branch under temporal transfer: the frozen margins grow ( + 2.9 +2.9 to + 3.4 +3.4 macro-F1 points for AlphaEarth, + 5.1 +5.1 to + 5.5 +5.5 for TESSERA), the scratch margins shrink ( + 3.2 +3.2 to + 2.4 +2.4 and + 2.6 +2.6 to + 1.2 +1.2 ), and the partially fine-tuned TESSERA branch stays below one point.
Geographic holdout (right) widens the margin in Mediterranean ( + 3.7 +3.7 vs + 3.0 +3.0 in-distribution); Alpine is positive but smaller ( + 1.1 +1.1 ), and Boreal is unstable ( + 0.5 +0.5 , sd 1.4, mixed signs); Mediterranean is thus the only clear geographic gain. Discussion. Ground-view KD helps most clearly when the satellite representation is fixed, and its margin can grow under domain shift. Operationally, the photo teacher is needed only during training; deployment requires a satellite-only head on the same embedding product. KD also outperforms alternative cross-modal objectives such as contrastive learning (Appendix C ). The comparison has limits. First, TESSERA fine-tuning uses the dataset’s monthly composites, for input consistency with the scratch transformers, whereas the frozen TESSERA model uses released embeddings produced through a different input path, a mismatch the − 7.4 -7.4 probe difference quantifies. Second, the geographic results are clear in the Mediterranean holdout, Boreal shows how quickly a small holdout can become noisy. Lastly, the transfer performance depend on the class itself, especially for the frozen TESSERA (Appendix D ).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
Ground photographs can provide privileged supervision for satellite crop classification without being required at inference. Their benefit is strongest for fixed pretrained satellite representations and persists, or increases, under temporal and geographic shift. Our ablations show that this gain is driven primarily by distillation of the teacher’s predictive structure rather than by cross-modal feature alignment.
The gain is consistent across all satellite branches with frozen-embedding margins grow further under temporal shift and in the Mediterranean holdout. This knowledge-distillation framework is particularly powerful from an operational perspective: field observations can be used to improve satellite models without imposing field-data requirements on large-scale deployment. This is especially relevant for scaling agricultural mapping and monitoring, where satellite imagery enables broad and repeated coverage but ground observations are costly to collect.
blocks.zh:
地面照片可以为卫星作物分类提供特权监督,无需推论。 固定的预先培训的卫星代表对卫星的惠益最大,在时间和地域变化的情况下,卫星代表的持续或增加。 校对:Soup
在所有卫星分支中,这种收益是一致的,在时间变化和地中海阻力下,冰封的边际进一步增长。 从业务角度看,这种知识分散框架特别强大:实地观测可用于改进卫星模型,而无需对大规模部署规定实地数据要求。 这与扩大农业测绘和监测工作特别相关,因为卫星图像能够使覆盖面广泛和重复,但地面观测收集费用昂贵。

blocks.en: Appendix A Additional experimental details
blocks.zh: 附录A 其他试验细节

blocks.en: The time series of satellite images is encoded using a lightweight sequence transformer model. Monthly spectral features are linearly projected into a shared latent space. The sequence is processed by pre-normalized Transformer blocks with multi-head self-attention, feed-forward layers, residual connections, and dropout. Mean pooling across all months, followed by LayerNorm, produces a single sequence representation.
blocks.zh: 卫星图像的时间序列采用轻量级序列变压器模型编码. 月谱特征线性地投射到一个共享的潜伏空间. 序列通过预先正常的变形器块进行处理,这些块具有多头自留心,向导层,剩余连接,以及退出. 整个月的平均集合,然后是LayerNorm, 产生一个单一的序列代表。

blocks.en: Precomputed photo features are mapped into a shared latent space using a two-layer projection head with LayerNorm and GELU activation. The resulting embedding is passed to an MLP classifier for crop type prediction. The trained photo teacher is frozen during student training and provides both embedding- and logit-level supervision.
blocks.zh: 预先计算的照片特征被映射成一个共享的潜伏空间,使用一个带有LayerNorm和GELU激活的双层投影头. 由此产生的嵌入被传递给一个MLP分类器,用于作物类型预测. 训练有素的摄影教师在学生培训期间被冻结,提供嵌入式和登录式监督。

blocks.en: Precomputed satellite features are transformed into the teacher’s latent space using an equivalent two-layer projection head. The projected embedding is concatenated with the original satellite feature vector and passed to an MLP classifier. Training combines supervised cross-entropy with logit- and embedding-level KD from the frozen photo teacher.
blocks.zh: 预先计算出来的卫星特征通过相等的两层投影头转化为教师的潜伏空间。 投影嵌入物与原始卫星特征矢量相配合,并传递给MLP分类器. 培训将受监督的交叉接触与冷冻照片教师的登录和嵌入级KD相结合。

blocks.en: The main KD runs use temperature T = 2 T=2 , logit-KD weight 1.0 1.0 , embedding-cosine weight 0.25 0.25 , and the same class-weighted CE term as the matched CE control. The student architecture, optimizer, split, and seed are paired within each KD–CE comparison.
blocks.zh: 主要KD运行使用温度T=2 T=2,logit-KD重量1.01.0,嵌入式-Cosine重量0.250.25,与匹配的CE控制相同级加权CE术语. 学生建筑,优化器,拆分,种子在每KD–CE比较中进行配对.

blocks.en: The 2022 evaluation reuses the 2018 class map and scaler and excludes points used for 2018 training or validation. In the geographic experiments the held-out ecoregion is fixed as test data; only the train/validation partition of the remaining points changes with seed.

blocks.en: We further examined whether ground-view distillation changes the temporal stability of the learned satellite representation. This analysis was performed on the partially fine-tuned TESSERA student, using the encoder features before the projection and classification heads. We matched the 2018 and 2022 LUCAS surveys by point identifier and retained only locations observed in both years whose crop label was unchanged. This resulted in 1,046 repeated locations from 10 crop classes; locations whose crop label changed between surveys were excluded because a change in representation is expected in that case.

blocks.en: Appendix C Contrastive Learning & Modality Fusion
blocks.zh: 附录C 矛盾学习和模式融合

blocks.en:
We further tested alternative cross-modal objectives, such as contrastive learning (CL), including a supervised contrastive (SupCon) [ Khosla et al., 2020 ] and CLIP-style instance contrastive (InfoNCE) [ van den Oord et al., 2018 , Radford et al., 2021 ] . SupCon adds a supervised contrastive loss across modalities with positives defined by shared crop class. In contrast, InfoNCE adds an instance-contrastive loss with positives defined by the same site, aligning each satellite point with its own photo against the rest of the batch. We tested the CL approaches on the frozen AlphaEarth embeddings, coupled with the CLIP photo embeddings and compared against the AlphaEarth and photo probe. We further include the performance for combining both modalities. For the fusion model both modalities are concatenated at the input level and fed into the classifier.
Results for 2018 are shown in Table 2 . Importantly, the CL objectives do not improve over the matched CE control (per-seed paired differences are small and mixed in sign), in contrast to the KD objective repeated in the table ( + 2.9 +2.9 macro-F1 paired over the CE student). The same dissociation holds within the distillation harness: adding only the logit-KL term to CE reproduces the full gain ( + 2.9 +2.9 macro-F1, positive on every seed), whereas adding only the embedding-cosine term is null ( + 0.2 +0.2 macro-F1, mixed signs). The CL objectives shape embeddings rather than predictive distributions, so their null result is consistent with the cosine-only control. In contrast, the macro-F1 of the photo probe is consistently about 6 pp higher than the CL objectives and both CE rows, which use the AlphaEarth embeddings only.
The combination of both modalities provides consistently the best results with approximately 8 pp higher macro-F1 than the photo probe model. This is expected, since this model receives complementary information that boosts crop classification performance but it cannot be used for inference in locations where no field photos are available.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步测试了其他的交叉模式目标,例如对比性学习(CL),包括监督对比性(SupCON)[Khosla等人,2020年]和CLIP式实例对比性(InfonCE)[van den] Oord et al., 2018., Radford et al., 2021] (中文(中国大陆) ). SupCon在各种模式中增加了有监督的对比性损失,其正值由共同作物类别界定。 相比之下,InfoNCE增加了一个与同一站点定义的正数的实例连续损失,使每个卫星点与自己的照片相对照其余批次. 我们在冷冻的阿尔法地球嵌入物上测试了CL方法,加上CLIP照片嵌入物,并与阿尔法地球和照片探测器进行比较。 我们还列入了将两种方式结合起来的绩效。 对于聚变模型来说,两种模式都是在输入一级组合,并输入分类器。
2018年的结果见表2。 重要的是,CL目标没有比对应的CE控制(每种子配对差异很小,在符号上混合)更好,与表中重复的KD目标(+2.9+2.9宏F1在CE学生身上配对)形成对比. 同样的分解在蒸馏带内持有:在CE中只添加logit-KL词来复制全部增益(每个种子上为正数的+2.9+2.9宏-F1),而只添加嵌入-Cosine词则无效(+0.2+0.2宏-F1,混合符号). CL目标形状嵌入而非预测分布,因此其无效结果与仅余弦控制一致. 相比之下,照片探测器的宏-F1始终比CL目标高约6pp,CE两行只使用AlphaEarth嵌入.
这两种模式的结合一致地提供了最佳结果,大约8pp的宏-F1比照片探测模型高。 由于该模型收到可提高作物分类性能的补充信息,但无法在没有野外照片的地点进行推论。

blocks.en: Appendix D Per-class analysis

blocks.en:
We further show the per-class results of the marcro-F1 score on the 2018 test set in Table 3 and for the temporal transfer in Table 4 . Notably, KD improves crop classification for most classes, except individual cases such as rice (89.0 to 88.9) for the frozen AlphaEarth embeddings. Moreover, paired KD − - CE macro-F1 margins per crop class for the temporal transfer is shown in Figure 4 , evaluated at 2022. Notably, performance gains depends on crop type and model branch, with + 38.9 +38.9 macro-F1 points for Flax/Hemp on the frozen TESSERA model and − 1.6 -1.6 on Rice for the TESSERA fine-tuned branch.
To demonstrate that the reported KD gain is not only driven by single class results, we show the macro-F1 score for a held-one-class-out validation in Figure 5 with stable gains, except for frozen TESSERA. For frozen TESSERA under temporal transfer, excluding the combined flax, cotton, and hemp class reduces the gain from 5.5 to 3.4 percentage points.
